structured_output.mechanisms: Time scales with epochs times conv FLOPs (stage widths weighted by spatial size), reduced by low-resolution phase fraction, plus small per-step overhead and a Muon cost. Accuracy rises with epochs and width (log), falls with low-res fraction, cutout, translate4, random flip, and label smoothing away from 0.1; Muon adds accuracy. The 0.753 accuracy threshold separates feasible from infeasible runs.
